crossRefs.note: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Keilah
people.line: A town in the Shephelah of Judah, rescued by David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
translations.bsb: Then Saul summoned all his troops to go to war at Keilah and besiege David and his men.
translations.kjv: And Saul called ➔ all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
translations.asv: And Saul summoned all the people to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
